Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities for target CHEMBL1743183. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid, join assays on activities.assay_id, join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter standard_type to IC50, standard_relation to exact '=', pchembl_value not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to first 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate.
